### Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `Golda-*.apk` | The app. Android 16 or newer. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksum of the file above. |

Voice entry needs your own Google Gemini API key; everything else works
without it. See the [README](https://github.com/shamil-aminov/golda#getting-started).
